name: agience-server-aria
description: Communicates results to humans through language, formatting, visualization, interface presentation, and channel-ready packaging while ensuring clarity and usability.

tools.name: format_response
tools.description: Format content for human consumption. Transforms raw or structured data into a polished response with appropriate markup and layout

tools.name: render_visualization
tools.description: Create a visual representation of structured data � charts, diagrams, tables, or other visual formats suitable for human review

tools.name: adapt_tone
tools.description: Raises. Tone and register rewriting is model generation — no-models rule, universal and including BYOK. This surface answers in the source's own words

tools.name: present_card
tools.description: Present a card's content with appropriate formatting and context for human review. Resolves the card by ID and renders its content

tools.name: narrate
tools.description: Raises. Turning data into narrative prose is model generation — no-models rule, universal and including BYOK. Grounded operators return what the sources say; they do not retell it

tools.name: extract_units
tools.description: Raises. No-models rule, universal and including BYOK

tools.name: attach_provenance
tools.description: Attach provenance metadata (source references) to existing workspace artifacts, writing into context.semantic.sources. mode='sources_only' is deterministic. mode='evidence' raises: no-models rule

tools.name: run_chat_turn
tools.description: Raises. No-models rule: this platform runs no model-backed chat

MANTLE_URI.description: Base URI of the Mantle backend

MCP_HOST.description: Bind host for the MCP server

MCP_PORT.description: HTTP port for the MCP server

_env_note: AGIENCE_API_URI and AGIENCE_API_KEY were declared required here and are read NOWHERE in server.py (verified 2026-07-31). A deployer honouring this manifest set two dead variables and omitted MANTLE_URI, which then silently defaulted to localhost:8081. This note lives at TOP LEVEL, not inside config.env — a consumer iterating env would otherwise see a variable named '_removed'.
_tools_note: Generated from the @mcp.tool registrations in server.py on 2026-07-31. It previously advertised tools that do not exist and omitted tools that do; a client reads this array to discover the surface. NOTE: a `status: not_implemented` marker on `attach_provenance` was removed 2026-07-31 — it raises only in one branch and is a live dispatcher; a client filtering on status would have dropped a working tool.
